topic: Volunteer examiners, element credit, temporary identification, remote operation (G1D; 12 pool questions)

questions.question: Who may receive partial credit for the elements represented by an expired amateur radio license?

choices.A: Any person who can demonstrate that they once held an FCC-issued General, Advanced, or Amateur Extra class license that was not revoked by the FCC
choices.B: Anyone who held an FCC-issued amateur radio license that expired not less than 5 and not more than 15 years ago
choices.C: Any person who previously held an amateur license issued by another country, but only if that country has a current reciprocal licensing agreement with the FCC
choices.D: Only persons who once held an FCC issued Novice, Technician, or Technician Plus license

questions.answer: Any person who can demonstrate that they once held an FCC-issued General, Advanced, or Amateur Extra class license that was not revoked by the FCC

questions.question: What license examinations may you administer as an accredited Volunteer Examiner holding a General class operator license?

choices.B: None, only Amateur Extra class licensees may be accredited

questions.question: On which of the following band segments may you operate if you are a Technician class operator and have an unexpired Certificate of Successful Completion of Examination (CSCE) for General class privileges?

choices.A: Only the Technician band segments until your upgrade is posted in the FCC database
choices.B: Only on the Technician band segments until you have a receipt for the FCC application fee payment
choices.C: On any General or Technician class band segment
choices.D: On any General or Technician class band segment except 30 meters and 60 meters

questions.answer: On any General or Technician class band segment

questions.question: Who must observe the administration of a Technician class license examination?

choices.A: At least three Volunteer Examiners of General class or higher
choices.B: At least two Volunteer Examiners of General class or higher
choices.C: At least two Volunteer Examiners of Technician class or higher
choices.D: At least three Volunteer Examiners of Technician class

questions.answer: At least three Volunteer Examiners of General class or higher

questions.question: When operating a US station by remote control from outside the country, what license is required of the control operator?

choices.B: Only an appropriate US operator/primary license and a special remote station permit from the FCC
choices.C: Only a license from the foreign country, as long as the call sign includes identification of portable operation in the US
choices.D: A license from the foreign country and a special remote station permit from the FCC

questions.question: Until an upgrade to General class is shown in the FCC database, when must a Technician licensee identify with “AG” after their call sign?

choices.A: Whenever they operate using General class frequency privileges
choices.B: Whenever they operate on any amateur frequency
choices.C: Whenever they operate using Technician frequency privileges
choices.D: A special identifier is not required if their General class license application has been filed with the FCC

questions.answer: Whenever they operate using General class frequency privileges

questions.question: Volunteer Examiners are accredited by what organization?
Which of the following criteria must be met for a non-US citizen to be an accredited Volunteer Examiner?

choices.A: The person must be a resident of the US for a minimum of 5 years
choices.B: The person must hold an FCC granted amateur radio license of General class or above
choices.C: The person’s home citizenship must be in ITU region 2
choices.D: None of these choices is correct; a non-US citizen cannot be a Volunteer Examiner

questions.answer: The person must hold an FCC granted amateur radio license of General class or above

questions.question: How long is a Certificate of Successful Completion of Examination (CSCE) valid for exam element credit?

choices.D: For as long as your current license is valid

questions.question: What is the minimum age that one must be to qualify as an accredited Volunteer Examiner?
What action is required to obtain a new General class license after a previously held license has expired and the two-year grace period has passed?

choices.A: They must have a letter from the FCC showing they once held an amateur or commercial license
choices.B: There are no requirements other than being able to show a copy of the expired license
choices.C: Contact the FCC to have the license reinstated
choices.D: The applicant must show proof of the appropriate expired license grant and pass the current Element 2 exam

questions.answer: The applicant must show proof of the appropriate expired license grant and pass the current Element 2 exam

questions.question: When operating a station in South America by remote control over the internet from the US, what regulations apply?

choices.A: Those of both the remote station’s country and the FCC
choices.B: Those of the remote station’s country and the FCC’s third-party regulations
choices.C: Only those of the remote station’s country

questions.answer: Only those of the remote station’s country
